ServiceInfraestrutura.metaTitle: IT infrastructure: servers, networks and backup
ServiceInfraestrutura.metaDescription: Organized servers, networks, backups and monitoring for a stable, documented technical environment that doesn't depend on a single person.
ServiceInfraestrutura.title: Infrastructure
ServiceInfraestrutura.lead: A stable technical foundation for the business to grow without relying on patchwork fixes.

sections.title: What's included
sections.body: We organize servers, networks, backups and the technical environment that keeps day-to-day operations running — in the simplest way that solves the problem, without unnecessary complexity.

sections.title: When it makes sense
sections.body: When the company's growth starts running into unstable systems, manual maintenance work, or dependence on a single person to keep everything running.

examples: Monitoring to catch problems before customers do
Migrating legacy systems without stopping operations
ServiceInfraestrutura.ctaTitle: Want a technical foundation that can handle growth?
ServiceInfraestrutura.ctaBody: Tell us what's holding things back today — we'll tell you plainly if infrastructure is the issue.
